build_dictionary_from_tokens: build a fairseq Dictionary vocabulary from a list of token lists using add_symbol and finalize
test_binarize_single_line: test binarizing a single text line into a tensor using VocabularyDatasetBinarizer and BinarizeSummary
test_binarize_file_chunk: test binarizing a chunk of a raw text file into an indexed dataset using FileBinarizer
test_multiprocess_binarization: test multiprocess binarization of a raw text file into an indexed dataset with multiple workers
compare_dataset_data: compare a binarization summary against expected data by verifying sequence count, token count, and decoded output
